Bikol-Naga: Dios marhay na aga saindong gabos.
Mabakal ako nin bag'o na libro asin papel sa saudan.
English Translation: I will buy a new book and paper at the market.

Bikol-Naga: Matanos asin tultol an pag-iisip nin magayon na maestra.
English Translation: The mindset of the beautiful teacher is honest and proper.

Bikol-Naga: Sinarado niya an bintana kan mag-uran nin makusog.
English Translation: She closed the window when it rained heavily.

Bikol-Naga: Magsimbag ka nin matanos sa mga hapot nin paratukdo.
English Translation: Answer correctly the questions of the teacher.

Bikol-Naga: Magayon an mga burak sa satong natad.
English Translation: The flowers in our yard are beautiful.

Bikol-Naga: Pusog an pundasyon kan bagong simbahan sa banwaan.
English Translation: The foundation of the new church in town is strong.

Bikol-Naga: Malisipon an mga aki na nagmamasid sa kapalibotan.
English Translation: The children observing the environment are very attentive.

Bikol-Naga: Mabalos sa saimong pagiging pasensyoso sa gabos na pagkakataon.
English Translation: Thank you for being patient on all occasions.

Bikol-Naga: Duman sa harayo na bulod, dakul an mga matao na kahoy.
English Translation: There on the distant hill, there are many generous trees.

Bikol-Naga: Siisay an maawit nin Bikol na kanta sa bilog na banwaan?
English Translation: Who will sing a Bikol song in the entire town?

Bikol-Naga: Dios mabalos sa Gabos na tabang asin pagpadaba nindo.
English Translation: God bless you for all your help and love.

Bikol-Naga: Ilaag mo an basura sa basurahan.
English Translation: Put the trash in the trash can.

Bikol-Naga: Matinabangon an mga tawo sa banwaan nin Naga.
English Translation: The people in the town of Naga are very helpful.

Bikol-Naga: Mag-ingat ka sa paglakaw sa kalsada ngunyan na uran.
English Translation: Be careful walking on the street in this rain.

Bikol-Naga: Aram mo daw kun sain an pinakarani na tindahan?
English Translation: Do you know where the nearest store is?

Bikol-Naga: Pwede tabi mahulam kan notes mo?
English Translation: May I borrow your notes, please?
How much are all of these?

Bikol-Naga: Mag-isip ka nin matanos bago ka magdesisyon sa buhay.
English Translation: Think properly before making a decision in life.

Bikol-Naga: Magbasa ka nin mga libro para maging madunong ka.
English Translation: Read books so you become wise.

Bikol-Naga: Magtaram ka nin katotohanan sa gabos na pagkakataon.
English Translation: Speak the truth on all occasions.

Bikol-Naga: Marhay na hapon sa sakong mga kapwa estudyante.
English Translation: Good afternoon to my fellow students.

Bikol-Naga: Ingat ka sa paglakaw sa madalandag na tinampo.
English Translation: Take care walking on the slippery road.

Bikol-Naga: Magbanlaw ka nin marhay pagkatapos mong magsabunon.
Maogma silang nagbabanwa sa banwaan nin Naga.
English Translation: They are happily residing in the town of Naga.

Bikol-Naga: Magbaba ka na diyan ta maduman na kita sa saod.
English Translation: Come down now as we are going to the market.

Bikol-Naga: Maogma an gabos na tawo sa kapiestahan nin banwaan.
English Translation: Everyone is happy during the town fiesta.

Bikol-Naga: Mabalos sa saimong pagpahalaga sa satong kultura.
English Translation: Thank you for your appreciation of our culture.

Bikol-Naga: Mag-ingat ka sa paglakaw paduman sa eskwelahan.
English Translation: Take care walking on your way to school.
Let us take care of our environment.

Bikol-Naga: Matinabangon an sakong tugang sa harong mi.
English Translation: My brother is so helpful in our house.

Bikol-Naga: Maglaba kita sa aga nin Sabado.
English Translation: Let us do laundry on Saturday morning.

Bikol-Naga: Marhay na banggi sa pamilya mo sa harong.
English Translation: Good evening to your family at home.
How are your studies right now?

Bikol-Naga: Mag-usipon kita sa irarom nin kahoy
English Translation: Let us talk under the tree
Let us study well in class.
Thank you for your kindness to me.
The cooked food is very delicious.

Bikol-Naga: Mag-inom ka nin mainit na kape.
Mag-ingat ka pirmi sa saimong paglakbay sa kalsada.
English Translation: Always take care on your journey on the road.

Bikol-Naga: Mabuot asin masipag an sakong mga katrabaho.
English Translation: My coworkers are kind and industrious.

Bikol-Naga: Nag-iingat an drayber sa madalandag na tinampo.
English Translation: The driver is careful on the slippery road.

Bikol-Naga: Naging maogma an gabos sa pagtiripon nin pamilya.
English Translation: Everyone became happy at the family gathering.

Bikol-Naga: Saindo an bag'ong kagamitan sa kwarto.
English Translation: The new equipment in the room is yours.

Bikol-Naga: Pano ta mababayadan an utang sa saod?
English Translation: How can we pay the debt at the market?

Bikol-Naga: Mabalos nin dakul sa saimong pagpadaba.
English Translation: Thank you very much for your love.

Bikol-Naga: Ano an gibuhon ta nganing makatabang sa kapwa?
English Translation: What shall we do to help others?

Bikol-Naga: Siisay an maiba sato paduman sa saod?
English Translation: Who will accompany us to the market?

Bikol-Naga: Mag-ingat ka pirmi sa saimong paglakaw sa kalsada.
English Translation: Always take care walking on the street.

Bikol-Naga: Kamo daw an mapuno nin tubig sa kusina?
English Translation: Will you be the ones to fill water in the kitchen?

Bikol-Naga: Marhay na hapon sa gabos na katrabaho.
Marhay na banggi sa pamilya Dini.
English Translation: Good evening to the family here.

Bikol-Naga: Gurano an presyo kan gulay asin isda saod?
English Translation: How much is the price of vegetables and fish?

Bikol-Naga: Mabalos sa gabos nindong pagpadaba asin katanusan.
English Translation: Thank you for all your love and righteousness.

Bikol-Naga: Nagtutubod kami sa katanusan asin katotohanan nin buhay.
English Translation: We believe in righteousness and the truth of life.
Thank you; may God repay you
